---
title: "Test CBE State vs GHGI"
output: github_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
source("R/utils.R")
source("R/StateEEIOFigures.R")
source("R/StateEEIOCalculations.R")
library(useeior)
library(knitr)
```



```{r getCAmodel}
rmarkdown::render('examples/DownloadandSaveModelLocally.Rmd', params =  list(states = c('CA'),model="v1.1-GHG",years=c(2019)))
model <- readRDS("models/CAEEIOv1.1-GHG-19.rds")

```


```{r calcCBE, echo=FALSE}
cbe <- calculateStateCBE(model)

cbe_agg_soi <- aggregateStateResultMatrix(model, cbe, region=state)

```



```{r printStateCBE, echo=FALSE}
kable(cbe_agg_soi, caption = "California CBE within State")
```

Total California CBE from CA in 2019 is `r sum(cbe_agg_soi)` metric tons CO2e.

```{r getGHGI}
ghgi <- getStateGHGI(model)

sum(ghgi[,"Greenhouse Gases"])
```

The total California GHGI from GHGI data for 2019 is `r sum(ghgi$ )` metric tons CO2e.
